title: Desperate Counterattack
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji turned to leave, his steps suddenly stopped—a half-broken stele was exposed beneath the rubble at the edge of the rift. Under the afterglow, the ancient carvings faintly glistened, and those two characters were clearly visible: Tianji.

text.content: That familiar Heavenly Fate fluctuation pierced into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a sharp blade. In an instant, his pupils constricted, and his aura involuntarily leaked out by half. For three years, he had traversed all thirty-six counties of Central Zhou, searched through ancient ruins, all for the master of this aura.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, have you been playing the废物 act long enough? Ling Yuan's voice came sinisterly from the other side of the rift. He stood on虚空, his gray-white robes billowing in the temporal chaos, his murky old eyes now blazing with sharp light. 'For three years, old fellow wants to see just how many hidden cards you've been concealing behind this Servant Disciple facade.'

Why bother wasting breath on him, Elder Ling! Han Lie's voice thundered like an explosion. His arms crossed before his chest, his body's qi and blood swirling like dragons and tigers. The late-stage 炼虚境 pressure poured out without any concealment. 'Last time at the Xuantian Secret Realm, I was outsmarted by his little tricks. Today, I will personally cement his废物 reputation!'

text.content: Chen Ji offered no answer. His consciousness remained fixed on that faint fluctuation—coming from the depths of the rift, intermingled within the violent temporal currents, yet painfully clear. It was the unique aura of the Heavenly Fate Key, Chen Nian, his sister.

choice.prompt: The encirclement by three major forces had formed a complete siege. Chen Ji was driven into a deadly ground of less than three zhang at the rift's edge. Ling Yuan and Han Lie each held their positions, while a hidden demonic path aura flickered in the shadows. At this life-and-death moment, how will he choose?

choices.description: Since they've pushed me this far, let them witness true strength. Protagonist's Halo activated—let them feel what it means to be crushed!
choices.visible_reward: Rise to fame, three major forces humiliated
choices.risk_hint: May expose too many trump cards, attracting attention from higher powers
choices.process_label: 陈机嘴角勾起一抹冷笑

text.content: Chen Ji slowly lifted his head. Those eyes, always as still as dead water, now suddenly blazed with a blinding golden light. His right hand rose slowly, and in his palm, a fist-sized dragon-shaped mark was awakening, emanating a terrifying ancient aura.

The Dragon Vein Core?! Ling Yuan's expression changed drastically. As a former candidate for the Tianji Record inheritance, he knew too well what that mark meant—it was the bloodline crystal of ancient dragons, a forbidden artifact capable of stabilizing temporal rifts.

choices.description: Use my sister's aura as bait first, then divide and conquer the enemy alliance. After all, Ling Yuan and Han Lie are not of one mind, each harboring their own calculations.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes more time, may miss the opportunity to rescue my sister
choices.visible_reward: Subdue the enemy without fighting, preserve strength
choices.risk_hint: The enemy may see through the scheme, falling into an even more passive situation

dialogue.content: Elder Ling, Brother Han, do either of you know where this rift leads? Chen Ji's voice was unhurried, even carrying a hint of amusement. 'Inside lies the Forbidden Grounds sealing the ancient Demon Ancestor's remains. The two of you joining forces against a mere servant disciple—could you possibly be using this chance to enter the Forbidden Grounds to seek treasures?'

choices.description: Sensing Su Qingyao is also nearby, call upon her 'Shared Destiny' buff at the critical moment, joining forces to fight the powerful enemies.
choices.visible_cost: May prematurely expose the relationship with Su Qingyao, attracting more enemies
choices.visible_reward: Support from the Inner Sect Senior Fellow, power multiplied
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may be exposed as a result, facing sect interrogation

dialogue.content: Chen Ji spoke calmly, "Qingyao, come out." His voice was not loud but clearly reached everyone present. A moment later, a sharp sword intent slashed from the void, and Su Qingyao's figure appeared at Chen Ji's side like a startled swan goose. Her fair hand pressed on her sword as she coldly said: "Who dares touch him?"

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶已与主角建立共命羁绊

text.content: Chen Ji didn't give Ling Yuan much time to think. Golden light blazed from his palm, and the dragon vein mark that had slept for a thousand years awakened completely at this moment. An ancient dragon's roar exploded from within him, deafening everyone present.

"Impossible!" Ling Yuan's face changed dramatically. He retreated several steps, his eyes filled with disbelief. "The dragon vein core is a forbidden artifact from ancient times. How could a Foundation Building kid like you possibly control it!"

dialogue.content: "Who told you I was at Foundation Building?" Chen Ji's smile grew colder. His momentum erupted like a volcano at this moment. Foundation Building, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, Transformation God, Void Refining—the barriers of five great realms shattered like thin paper on him, and the pressure of the Void Refining peak poured out.

"You—!" Han Lie's pupils contracted sharply. He finally realized the terror of this "waste." But it was too late. Chen Ji's right hand was already pressed against his chest, and a dragon-shaped True Qi pierced through, blasting him into the distant cliff wall.

text.content: "One person's strength, suppressing three Void Refining cultivators!" This scene shocked everyone present. Ling Yuan spat blood and retreated repeatedly, while the hidden demonic path expert was so frightened that he directly fled into the void. Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, dragon vein power swirling around him, like a deity descending to earth.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan was severely wounded and retreated, but before leaving, a strange glint flashed in his eyes, as if he still had a hidden move. Chen Ji faced a choice: pursue and eliminate him completely, or first stabilize the rift seal and search for his sister?

choices.description: Root out the weeds and leave no future troubles. This old fox must be eliminated today, or he will become a major threat later.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate, and may miss traces of sister
choices.visible_reward: Eliminate the biggest hidden danger, Ling Yuan perishes completely
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may have a lifesaving trump card, and end up being outmaneuvered instead

dialogue.content: "Old Ling, farewell." Chen Ji raised his hand, and a dragon-shaped sword qi tore through the air. However, just as the sword qi was about to touch Ling Yuan, an inexplicable force devoured it entirely. Ling Yuan looked back with a sinister smile: "Chen Ji, did you think this old man had no preparations? Within this rift, there is the aura of that great one..."

choices.description: My sister's aura comes from the depths of the rift, and the seal may collapse at any moment. Save people first, settle accounts later.
choices.visible_cost: Spare Ling Yuan, may counterattack in the future
choices.visible_reward: Opportunity to venture deep into the rift to find Chen Nian and uncover more truths
choices.risk_hint: There may be greater dangers in the depths of the rift

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and turned to face the violent temporal-spatial rift. His hands formed ancient mudras, and the dragon vein power transformed into a golden barrier, slowly covering the rift's edge. The violent turbulence gradually calmed before this barrier, revealing a deep void within the rift.

Just as Chen Ji was fully stabilizing the rift seal, his divine sense suddenly tensed—that pair of eyes transcending heavenly Dao appeared in his perception once more. It was the will of Chess Piece Number 49, another gaze from the Eyes of Heavenly Dao upon him.

It was an indescribable pressure, as if the entire heavens and earth were scrutinizing him. Chen Ji felt his fate trajectory exposed under that gaze, every page of the Tianji Record being flipped through, recorded, and calculated. He endured the agonizing pain in his divine sense and gritted his teeth to persist.

dialogue.content: "Child, it's watching." The remnant soul of Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, aged and grave. "It has always been watching. The heavenly fate struggle you think you're in is merely chess pieces clashing on its board. But remember—" His voice suddenly dropped lower. "Even chess pieces have the day they flip the board."

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer. He deeply carved these words into his heart, then abruptly increased his output. Dragon vein power surged out like a bursting flood, building an impregnable seal at the rift's edge. That watching gaze lasted about three breaths of time before slowly receding.

The battle was over. Han Lie was blasted into the cliff wall with unknown survival, Ling Yuan fled with severe injuries, and the hidden demonic path expert had long vanished without a trace. The news that Chen Ji alone had subdued three Void Refining experts would spread like wings across the entire Central Region.

But the current Chen Ji had no attention for any of this. His complete focus was on that faint aura from the rift's depths—that was Chen Nian's Heavenly Fate fluctuation, the clue he had desperately sought for three years. The seal was temporarily stabilized, but the rift's depths remained an unfathomable abyss.

Just as Chen Ji was about to delve deeper into the rift, his footsteps suddenly halted. Behind him, beneath the broken stones at the edge of the seal, a half-buried stele was revealed. The setting sun's glow fell upon it, illuminating its mottled surface—two ancient characters became clearly visible: Tianji.

Chen Ji bent down, gently brushing away the dust from the stele. The stele's material was neither gold nor jade, yet it faintly emanated an aura similar to the Tianji Record Fragment within his body. His heart stirred, and gathering spiritual energy at his fingertips, he slowly reached toward the broken stele—suddenly, an ancient piece of information flooded directly into his Mental Sea.
